name: Enlightened Strike
text:
As an additional cost to play Enlightened Strike, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
Choose 1;
- When you attack with Enlightened Strike, draw a card.
- Enlightened Strike gains +2{p}.
- Enlightened Strike gains go again.

name: Heart of Fyendal
text:
Legendary
When you pitch Heart of Fyendal, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, gain 1{h}.

name: Eye of Ophidia
text:
Legendary
When you pitch Eye of Ophidia, opt 2.

name: Riches of Trōpal-Dhani
text:
Legendary
When this is pitched, create a Gold token.

name: Balance of Justice
text:
Instant - Destroy this: Draw a card. Activate this only if an opponent has drawn 2 or more cards this turn.
Guardwell

name: Crown of Providence
text:
When you defend with Crown of Providence, you may put a card from your hand or arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.
Blade Break

name: Fyendal's Spring Tunic
Stonewall Gauntlet
text:
When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, opposing attacks get -1{p} this combat chain.
Blade Break

name: Quickdodge Flexors
text:
Defense Reaction - {r}: Add this to the active chain link as a defending card. It has 2 base {d} this chain link.
At the beginning of the end phase, if this defendend this turn, destroy it.

name: Command and Conquer
text: Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link. When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal.

name: Shelter from the Storm
text: Instant - Discard this: The next 3 times you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 1 of that damage.

name: Amnesia
text: When this hits a hero, cards and tokens they own lose and can't gain names until the start of your next turn.

name: Censor
text: When this hits a hero, name a card. They can't play the named card until the end of their next turn.

name: Cut Through the Facade
text:
This can't be defended by auras.
When this hits a hero, you may destroy an aura they control.

name: Ripple Away
text: Instant - Discard this: If an action card effect would create 1 or more tokens this turn, instead it creates that many minus 1 of each of those tokens.

name: Tenacity
text: When this attacks, it gets +X{p}, where X is the number of defending cards on the combat chain.

name: The Weakest Link
text: When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card without base {d}. If you do, they discard it and you draw a card.

name: Hold the Line
text: If the attacking hero has drawn 2 or more cards this turn, prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn.

name: That All You Got?
text: While this is defending an attack with 2 or less {p}, when the combat chain closes, draw a card.

name: Call to the Grave
text:
Search your deck for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
Go again

name: Gorganian Tome
text:
Legendary
Draw X cards, where X is 1 plus the number of Gorganian Tomes in all graveyards.
Go again

name: Midas Touch
text:
Destroy target ally. Its controller creates Gold tokens equal to its cost.
Go again

name: Premeditate
text:
The next time an attack action card hits a hero this turn, create a Ponder token.
The next attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

name: Rusted Relic
text: Arcane Barrier 1

name: This Round's on Me
text:
Each hero draws a card.
Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target you have -1{p}.
Go again

name: Truce
text:
When this enters the arena, choose an opponent.
At the beginning of their end phase, destroy this and you each gain 3{h}.
When you or a card you control is the target of an attack they control, destroy this and draw a card.

name: Remembrance
text:
Shuffle up to 3 action cards from your graveyard into your deck.
Banish Remembrance.

name: Seduce Secrets
text:
Look at target hero's hand and the top card of their deck.
If this was played from arsenal, draw a card.

name: Looking for a Scrap
text: As an additional cost to play Looking for a Scrap, you may banish a card with 1{p} from your graveyard. When you do, this gains +1{p} and go again.

name: Ravenous Rabble
text:
When this attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. This gets -X{p}, where X is the pitch value of the card revealed this way.
Go again

name: Scar for a Scar
text: When this is played, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, it gets go again.

name: Snatch
text: When this hits, draw a card.

name: Pummel
Fate Foreseen
text: Opt 1

name: Sink Below
text: You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.

name: Oasis Respite
text: Prevent the next 4 damage that would be dealt to target hero this turn by a source of your choice. If they have less life than each other hero, they may gain 1{h}.

name: Sigil of Solace
text: Gain 3{h}

name: Fiddler's Green
text: When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, gain 3{h}.
